anomalies.description: A sudden bright flash and rapid expansion of fire and smoke erupts from the lower-right portion of a multi-level industrial or construction structure, consistent with an explosion.
A sudden bright flash and rapid expansion of smoke/debris occurs at the lower center of the frame, consistent with a small explosion or detonation near a vehicle or structure.

A vehicle (likely a motorcycle or scooter with two helmeted riders) is involved in a violent impact or rollover; visible deformation, sparks/fire, and disorientation of riders persist across frames, indicating a crash sequence rather than a static scene.

Two individuals wearing white helmets appear to be engaged in close physical struggle on an elevated platform; one is leaning over the other in a manner suggestive of grappling or restraint, though visibility is severely limited by smoke and motion blur.
A bright flash and expanding fireball with smoke emanates from a structure near two individuals wearing white helmets, consistent with a sudden explosive event.

After the explosion, debris is visible and the scene shifts; in later frames (f11–f15), a vehicle appears to be involved in a crash or overturning on the ground level, though obscured by smoke and camera motion.

A sudden, violent explosion occurs at the industrial facility, producing a large white fireball and rapid expansion of smoke/gas from the central structure; visible in frames f0–f2.; A secondary explosion or intense ignition event occurs on the right side of the facility, marked by a bright orange flash and rapidly growing fire plume; visible in frames f3–f5.; A third distinct explosive event or major structural failure with ejection of debris and intensified fire occurs near the lower-right section of the plant; visible as a sharp increase in flame and smoke in frames f6–f8.

A large, sudden fireball erupts from the industrial structure, characteristic of a rapid deflagration or explosion, fully engulfing the upper section in bright white-yellow flame within a fraction of a second.; A sudden, massive fireball erupts from the industrial facility, indicating a violent explosion. The blast is instantaneous and fills the frame with intense white-yellow flame and expanding gases.; Sustained post-detonation fire and secondary explosions continue at the site, with large flames, black smoke, and structural disintegration visible. This represents the immediate aftermath of the initial blast, including possible fuel-fed fireball propagation and additional energetic events.

A large, sustained fireball and rapidly expanding plume of black smoke erupt from an industrial facility (likely storage tanks), consistent with a major explosion or catastrophic fire event. The initial bright flash and rapid expansion in frames f0–f1 indicate a detonation or violent rupture, followed by intense burning and smoke generation through f15.

A large, violent explosion with bright orange fireball and rapidly expanding black smoke, viewed through vertical bars; multiple frames show the initial blast and rapid fire growth.; Secondary explosions or intense fire propagation following the initial blast, with continued bright flames, debris movement, and thick smoke; scene remains highly dynamic and destructive.
A sudden, bright flash and rapid expansion of fire and smoke at the center of the vehicle structure, consistent with a detonation or fuel tank rupture.

A multi-vehicle collision involving large vehicles (possibly buses or trucks) that has resulted in a sustained post-impact fire and structural deformation; the accident appears to have occurred just before or at the start of the clip and continues through the sequence.
